definition: the arithmetic behind reinventing the path rather than following anyone's

settled:
I have put a ridiculous amount of time and effort into building robust conceptual maps of everything, because that's the only way I can understand the world.

Interest tracks the edge of the map, the region a model does not cover yet or covers thinly. That is where my attention goes.

At least eighty percent of that edge, by attention, is the map of myself.

A common pattern transfers to me at most one time in ten, so at least nine tenths of what I am working on has no borrowed pattern that applies.

When I invent my own solution instead, it sits comfortably inside standard social convention at most one time in five.

Chain the three: eighty percent of ninety percent of eighty percent is about fifty eight percent. So most of what I am focused on cannot be checked against either circle, not against someone who knows me and not against the culture.

That is why I would rather reinvent the path than follow anyone's footsteps. The borrowed map was never going to cover this ground.

title: Why Most Of What I Work On Is Outside Both Circles
